test_plan.strategy: Table-driven Go unit tests for the NUT parser, status→state mapping and battery estimator against an in-process simulated upsd (mock.go); integration tests against the real SQLite DB for ups_samples/ups_events persistence, purge and the alert-engine UPS evaluators; e2e tests (Playwright-style, driving the live dashboard with ULTRON_UPS_MOCK) for the UPS card and shutdown-config block across states and the 375px mobile viewport. Every regression NFR gets the full happy/edge/negative set; NFR-019 (security) gets ≥3 distinct failure modes. Mock-driven so no physical UPS or prod deploy is needed (NFR-022).
test_plan.coverage_goal: 85% of new internal/ups statements; 100% of MUST FRs and regression NFRs with happy+edge+negative.

test_cases.title: NUT client parses LIST VAR into a variable map
preconditions: mock upsd serving powest with a canned LIST VAR reply
test_cases.given: a simulated upsd on 127.0.0.1:0 returns 'VAR powest ups.status "OL"', 'VAR powest ups.load "2"', 'VAR powest input.voltage "122.0"', 'VAR powest battery.voltage "27.1"', terminated by 'END LIST VAR powest'
test_cases.when: Poller performs one poll via Client.List(ctx)
test_cases.then: returned map contains ups.status="OL", ups.load="2", input.voltage="122.0", battery.voltage="27.1"; no error
test_cases.expected_result: map has 4 keys with exact values above; err == nil

test_cases.title: Client marks UPS unreachable after timeout with backoff, no panic
preconditions: mock upsd that accepts one poll then closes the listener
test_cases.given: the poller has one successful poll, then upsd stops accepting connections; UnreachableTimeout=2m, PollInterval=10s (compressed to ms in test)
test_cases.when: the poller keeps polling past the unreachable timeout
test_cases.then: Poller.Current().Reachable==false and State=="unreachable"; reconnect attempts increase with backoff (delays non-decreasing); no panic and the goroutine is still alive
test_cases.expected_result: State transitions to "unreachable"; recover() catches nothing (no panic); at least 2 reconnect attempts recorded with backoff

test_cases.title: Client exposes no write path and never execs upsc
preconditions: recording mock upsd that logs every command line it receives
test_cases.given: a full poll cycle runs against the recording mock
test_cases.when: all commands sent by the client during the cycle are inspected, and the Client interface is examined
test_cases.then: only LIST/GET/USERNAME/PASSWORD lines were sent — zero SET, INSTCMD, or shutdown/load.off commands; the Client interface declares no write/SET method; no os/exec of upsc occurred
steps: Assert command log contains no SET/INSTCMD
test_cases.expected_result: command log matches ^(USERNAME|PASSWORD|LIST|GET) only; exec counter == 0

test_cases.title: Parser stays stable over production-scale poll volume
test_cases.given: the mock upsd replies to 8640 sequential polls (one day at 10s interval) with varying values
test_cases.when: the parser processes all 8640 replies
test_cases.then: all parse without error, allocations stay bounded (no leak of connections), and the last parsed map matches the last reply
test_cases.expected_result: 8640/8640 parsed, err==nil each; final map equals final canned reply
